document.title: Add per-story summaries under Overview part headers
document.summary: Validate a document `parts[]` list that matches group `part`, and Overview shows that one-sentence what under each colored column title.
document.why: [The request](source:s1) asked for a document `parts` list and a one-sentence what under each Overview part header, not in the Sidebar.

sources.label: Cursor session · Sep 19
sources.gist: Asks for document parts[] plus Overview column summaries, not Sidebar.

lookFor: [The request](source:s1) says not to add the blurb to the Sidebar. `src/ui/components/Sidebar.tsx` has no part summary markup.

parts.name: Schema
parts.summary: The review document gains `parts[]`, and validate requires those names to match group `part`.

parts.name: Overview
parts.summary: Overview shows the part summary under the colored column title.

groups.title: Document parts array
groups.why: [The request](source:s1) names a document-level `parts` list whose `name` matches group `part`.
groups.summary: `review.ts` adds `parts[]` and fails when a named group `part` has no matching entry, or a listed name is unused.
lookFor: A group with `part: "Flags"` and no `parts[]` fails with `part "Flags" has no matching parts[] entry`.

groups.title: Cite sources in part summaries
groups.why: It enables later groups that treat part `summary` as prose.
groups.summary: `source.ts` walks `parts[].summary` for `source:` ids the same way it walks document and group prose.

groups.title: Parse and schema tests
groups.why: The contract needs tests for matching names, orphans, duplicates, empty summaries, and the skill example.
groups.summary: `parse.test.ts` covers matching and failing `parts[]`, and `source.test.ts` includes `parts[0].summary` in citation walks.

groups.title: Skill writes parts[]
groups.why: [The request](source:s1) asks agents to write one `parts[]` entry per independent story.
groups.summary: The next skill's what and grouping rules require a `parts[]` entry per `part`, and the example JSON has two.

groups.title: Eval packet and prose lints
groups.why: It enables graders to see part summaries.
groups.summary: The grading packet lists `parts[]`, and prose lints walk each part summary.

groups.title: Generated schema and skill copies
groups.why: Mechanical copies of the schema and next skill.
groups.summary: `pnpm generate:schema` and `pnpm sync:skill` write the JSON Schema and the `.agents` skill tree.

groups.title: Overview part header summary
groups.why: [The request](source:s1) puts the one-sentence what under the colored Overview column title only.
groups.summary: `PartColumn` looks up `document.parts` by name and renders the summary under the uppercase title, clamped to two lines.
lookFor: The part summary sits in the Overview column header, muted, `line-clamp-2`, and the Sidebar part header is still name-only.

groups.title: partSummary lookup
groups.why: It covers the Overview lookup without a browser harness.
groups.summary: `partSummary` returns the listed sentence for a titled part and nothing when the name is missing.

commits.subject: Add per-story summaries under Overview part headers.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Document parts[] holds one one-sentence what per independent story. Validate requires those names to match group part, and Overview shows the summary under each colored column title.
